methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with three primary businesses: Comcast Cable, NBCUniversal and Sky' (FY2020 10-K); 'As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming and other OTT services, the number of Cable Communications’ video customers and subscribers to NBCUniversal’s cable networks decrease, even as Cable Communications’ high-speed internet services become more important to consumers'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast

theme_watch.reason: Live: Comcast's own FY2020 10-K says 'Changes in consumer behavior driven by online video distribution platforms for viewing content continue to adversely affect our businesses and challenge existing business models. As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming and other OTT services, the number of Cable Communications’ video customers and subscribers to NBCUniversal’s cable networks decrease, even as Cable Communications’ high-speed internet services become more important to consumers.' At the same time it runs its own direct-to-consumer service: 'Peacock, our new direct-to-consumer streaming service that features NBCUniversal content, which was made available to Comcast customers in April 2020 and launched across the United States in July 2020'. The stock trades at 26.1x FY21E — a premium. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of streaming to 2015-08-04 (Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off), evidence that names Disney's networks, not Comcast. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (STREAMING) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing streaming substitution of Comcast's video customers or networks specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with three primary businesses: Comcast Cable, NBCUniversal and Sky' (FY2020 10-K); 'As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming and other OTT services, the number of Cable Communications’ video customers and subscribers to NBCUniversal’s cable networks decrease, even as Cable Communications’ high-speed internet services become more important to consumers'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 6.86x; +74% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.60; conservative 2yr -2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.4%/yr (worst year FY11-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +22.5%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +22.5%/yr (FY11-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +25.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2021-08-27) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 6.86x (64.6% downside to Bear $21 / +9.4% upside to Bull $65) | Adj composite 2.15 vs market 3.75: gap -1.60 [OVERVALUED] | +74% above the EPP floor $34 (15x FY21E $2.28) | Conservative 2-yr case: -1.8% total (-0.9%/yr) | At 26.1x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $79 sits above the BULL case; video subscribers -6.9% in Q2 2021, forward revenues +20.4% (no FY21 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2021 revenue growth); streaming is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
